Vindicators takes place in the year 2 Galaxy TRIS. The mission is to intercept and de: the invading forces from the evi] Tangent Empire, The goal is to proceed through multi-level stations, securing each by demolishing its control center. The invaders have 14 space stations equipped with turrets and highly mobile armored tanks that constantly patrol the Tangent’s fortifications. The SR-88 battle tanks are powerful, but their fuel supply is very volatile. The players must constantly replenish their fuel supply by picking up fuel canisters at the many levels of the stations. Operator options on this game have been kept very simple.
